Billy Ray Bates hiya yaba ga ppqumah,Billy Ray Bates laqi nya.mrkay's maki Mississippi sharecroppers. Billy Ray Bates mzyu mari maki McAdams gocyu.suruw lga mzyu mari maki Kentucky hopa pqwasan biru. pincyuwagan nya' pspngan mari sa may yugal yacing masuq mspung mari sa pspngan mari na maycyugal byacing lga cinkhulan sa knita' sa brbiru' Lists of National Basketball Association players
